name: Castril (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castril (a castle and towers on green within an inscribed bordure, with a scroll reading Ayuntamiento de Castril).
history: Municipal flag of Castril; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castril arms — castle and towers on green within an inscribed bordure, with scroll
bordure and scroll of the arms
